Starring Usher Raymond & Chris BrownPresale: 04/21/2026, 12:00 PM CDTSeptember 10, 2026Thursday 07:00 PMArlington, TXAT&T StadiumThe R&B Tour - Starring Usher Raymond & Chris BrownGalleryAboutUSHER has cemented his status as a generation-defining superstar over a three-decade career. After releasing his 1997 breakthrough album My Way — his first album to make the Top 5 on the Billboard 200 — he defined the 2000s with Billboard Hot 100 No.1 hits like “Yeah!” (featuring Lil Jon and Ludacris), “OMG” (featuring will.i.am) and “Love in This Club” (featuring Young Jeezy). USHER’s diamond-certified album Confessions (2004) marked his first No. 1 on the Billboard 200 and produced four No.1 hits, including “My Boo” featuring Alicia Keys. The eight-time Grammy Award winner launched his “My Way” Las Vegas residency in July 2022 and followed it with the Past Present Future Tour. In 2024, USHER headlined the Super Bowl Halftime Show. The tour is set to begin in June with a show in Denver, followed by stops in cities like Detroit, Nashville, Chicago, Las Vegas, and El Paso. The R&B Tour will wrap in December 2026.Be sure to add USHER to your favorites on Ticketmaster.com(Opens in new tab) or in the Ticketmaster App to get important alerts about his concerts. (Download the Ticketmaster App for iPhone(Opens in new tab) or Android(Opens in new tab).)USHER and Chris Brown will begin The R&B Tour on June 26 at Empower Field at Mile High in Denver.Tickets to The R&B Tour will be available via Ticketmaster. You can sign up to join the Artist Presale(Opens in new tab) now through Tuesday, April 21 at 10:00 p.m. ET. You must sign up by April 21 at 10:00 p.m. ET to participate in the Artist Presale. The Artist Presale will take place on Thursday, April 23 at 12:00 p.m. local time. A general ticket sale is scheduled for Monday, April 27 at 12:00 p.m. local time.
